title: Making a cat fighting game over the weekend!
author: GTTGgames
selftext:
Soon you will be able to fight for the right to call yourself the strongest cat in the universe! 

Got inspired by a random image of cats fighting that I had made, and decided to just make the game. Will update it but gonna just drop the 1 player version on [itchi.io](http://itchi.io) tomorrow!
